data.summary: Could not execute the reported fueled-generator payload explosion. A local editor map was created and playtested; a Core Shard was added so the playtest launched, and the Steam Generator was identified and selected. However, the intended infinite-resources rule was not effective in the launched playtest (the placed generator remained a construction ghost due to missing lead/graphite/silicon). Consequently I could not construct, fuel, damage, transport, explode, retrieve, place, or reload the target block.
